title: The dashboard lists the models each host can run, and adds or removes one
name: models-screen
description: `sober models` and `sober models add <name> "<run>" --complexity 1-3` (packages/cli/src/models.ts) are command-line only, and nothing removes a model. Add a read route and a write route over core's models.ts with tests, and a screen that lists per host (`claude`, `codex`, `openrouter`) every model Jev could pick — the list live-list builds from the catalogues, `dispatch.sources` and the pins in `dispatch.models` — with the tier each covers. Every model row has a remove: a catalogue model gets a `deny` entry for its id in that source's `dispatch.sources` block, a pinned entry is deleted from `dispatch.models`. Add works two ways: pick a model from a host's catalogue (lifts a matching `deny`, or pins it when a filter still keeps it out) or type a pin by hand (name, run line, complexity) — e.g. adding `fable` to Claude when it is not in the table. The CLI gains `sober models remove <name>` writing the same change, so the command line and the dashboard never disagree. Writes go through core, never the config file text by hand, and keep the config's comments. Waits on live-list, which defines the list and `dispatch.sources`. Delete the models entry from KNOWN_GAPS.
